nativeAcceptance.launchMethod: Native CUA getApp with exact installed app path

repeatSteps: Export git archive HEAD and overlay only the five rename-related Swift files listed in source-manifest.json; keep unfinished search field source excluded.
Build release greenbubbles-history; stage with stage-local-brand-update.py --source OLD_APP --identity EXISTING_CERT --main-executable REBUILT_MAIN --output NEW_DIRECTORY.
Compare old/candidate Bundle ID, certificate, designated requirement, entitlements and every CLI/helper SHA-256; run codesign --verify --deep --strict.
Quit through native UI and confirm process absence; back up old installed bundle, install WeSync.app and create GreenBubbles.app -> WeSync.app compatibility symlink.
Cold-launch exact /Applications/WeSync.app using native UI, select a conversation and refresh; check WeSync sidebar, application menu, status-menu open/quit and hide/reopen.
Quit via WeSync status menu, confirm process absence, cold-launch again and refresh without entering credentials.
Verify legacy app alias and command resolve to current bundled CLI; verify private repository and origin; wait for pushed-commit CI.
limitations: Results cover this Mac and the existing signing identity; expiry, locked Keychain, different identity or another machine require their own acceptance.
Public Developer ID distribution/notarization and a future changed-CLI upgrade through the compatibility alias were not exercised.
